residual_wall_definition: request total_request_ms - prefill_ms - request decode_ms; includes HTTP/host/runtime remainder and any unseparated save/update work

residual_wall_ms.interpretation: The measured wall time is dominated by prefill and decode. Restore is separately instrumented and is negligible; save/update is not separately instrumented.

checkpoint_and_memory.memory_note: The server log provides startup free/total VRAM and checkpoint bytes, but no per-request VRAM peak series.

semantics_observed.reuse_continuation: suffix-only continuation; zero-suffix can use the retained final hidden state
semantics_observed.persistent_sessions: disk sessions select the longest matching prefix, but serialized sessions do not carry final hidden state
semantics_observed.invalidations: cold/fallback requests reset or replace the active in-memory checkpoint

observability_limits: save/update time is not a separate telemetry field and is included in the prefill or residual remainder
the residual wall definition is an uninstrumented remainder, not a direct kernel-time measurement
per-request VRAM peaks are not emitted by the serving telemetry
